verdict.rationale: Evidence describes Smithery only as a hosted registry/platform (registry.smithery.ai, server.smithery.ai) with OAuth-gated hosted MCP endpoints; 'Uplink' lets users expose their own local MCP server as a connection into the hosted Smithery service, but this is not self-hosting the Smithery platform itself. No docs, GitHub repo, or probes indicate a self-hostable/open-source deployment of the core product.
